name: CodedDirections
title: Coded directions (NHG Tabel 25)
description: The NHG Tabel 25 coded usage instruction, verbatim, e.g. '3-4D1S; gedurende max. 1 maand'.
purpose: FHIR models dosing structurally (Dosage.timing, Dosage.doseAndRate) and has no slot for a compact coded string. HL7 NL registers OIDs for Tabel 25 components — tijdseenheden 2.16.840.1.113883.2.4.4.3, aanvullende teksten 2.16.840.1.113883.2.4.4.5 — but not for the composite string.

element.definition: The NHG Tabel 25 coded usage instruction, verbatim, e.g. '3-4D1S; gedurende max. 1 maand'.

element.short: The coded instruction, passed through undecoded
element.comment: Authoritative in both directions: fhir-hub writes it and reads it back, so a host that edits the dosing must edit this, not Dosage.text. No timing or doseAndRate is derived from it — an earlier version did, and it was lossy.
